tools.name: postcard_start
tools.description: Start one virtual pet trip when the user asks. Duration is real waiting time; generation may take additional time. Only one unfinished trip is allowed.

summary.zh: 开始一趟现实时间等待的旅行。

tools.name: postcard_status
tools.description: Read the current trip and availability. awaiting_service means a generator is not connected; do not claim a postcard exists.

summary.zh: 查看旅行与服务连接状态。

tools.name: postcard_read
tools.description: Read a completed postcard title and note by trip id.

summary.zh: 读取一份已完成的旅行短笺。

tools.name: postcard_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a trip on user request. A remote request already sent may still incur a charge.

tools.name: postcard_retry
tools.description: Manually retry a failed trip only after the user requests it. For an uncertain image outcome, set confirmUnknownOutcome only after the user has explicitly confirmed checking the previous result and possible charge.

confirmUnknownOutcome.description: True only after the user explicitly confirms the uncertain previous request and possible charge.

summary.zh: 按用户要求重试失败旅程。
summary.en: Retry a failed trip on user request.

description.zh: 旅行核心已加载及生成服务可用情况。
description.en: Travel core mounted and generator availability.

description.zh: 明信片已完整保存到收藏。

prompts.title: 旅行环境说明
prompts.content:
你可以通过 postcard 工具管理虚拟旅行和明信片收藏。当前：{{postcard.availability}}。
只在用户提出旅行需求时出发，不自行开始收费任务。到期时间是旅行等待结束，图片准备还需要时间。
只有 postcard_read/list 确认存在的收藏才可描述为已收到。awaiting_service 不能说成正在实际生图。
失败不会自动重新收费；用户要求重试前，要先确认上次远端结果。取消可能无法撤销已提交远端请求。
工具提供的旅程是外部环境状态，不表示你获得了新的关系记忆，不编造与用户的共同经历。
